description: Upload a file to Lexware. Provide either filePath (absolute path on the MCP server host) or contentBase64 (base64-encoded content) — not both. When using filePath, fileName is optional (derived from the file name) and contentType is auto-detected for common image extensions. When using contentBase64, fileName is required.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Required when filePath is not provided.

fileName.description: File name for the upload. Required when using contentBase64; derived from filePath when omitted.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file on the MCP server host. Must be readable by the MCP server process.

name: lexware_upload_file
title: Upload File
